race.comment: SUBSIDING (9) savaged the line first up with an encouraging fourth over 1110m at Lismore. Finds a very weak Maiden and should prove too good for these. CHECKS'N'BALANCES (2) gave away a big start at the top of the straight and failed to make an impression when seventh over 1370m at Bowraville. Finds a suitable assignment and placed at this track. HEY KALUMBA (3) snagged back from the outside draw at his second race start with a battling seventh over 1015m contest at Grafton. Can race closer from the rails draw and take a hand in the finish. PRESTIGE EXOTIC (8) drops in trip after finishing in the minor money at his third career start. Respect from the gate.
